svg.title: Posterior predictive counts from NUTS compared with exact beta-binomial probabilities
svg.desc: Probability mass over counts out of twenty trials, comparing prior prediction and NUTS posterior prediction with the exact beta-binomial reference. Predictive count spread includes future sampling variation.
